rows.note: Use 故事 as the all-purpose noun for a real or fictional account of events.

example.english: I heard this story when I was little.
example.traditional: 呢個故事係我細個嗰陣聽過嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gu3 si6 hai6 ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 teng1 gwo3 ge3

rows.note: Use 大話 when the “story” is a lie or made-up claim rather than a narrative.

example.english: I exposed your story as a lie ages ago.
example.traditional: 你啲大話，我一早就踢爆咗。
example.jyutping: nei5 di1 daai6 waa6 ngo5 jat1 zou2 zau6 tek3 baau3 zo2

rows.note: Use 咩事 in a colloquial question about what is going on or what the situation is.

example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 gan2 zoeng1 me1 si6 aa3

rows.note: Use 肥皂劇 specifically for a serialized melodramatic television drama.

example.english: Mum follows the story in this soap opera every day.
example.traditional: 阿媽日日追呢套肥皂劇。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 jat6 jat6 zeoi1 ni1 tou3 fei4 zou6 kek6
